title: Apartment Home Lease Floor Plan Schedule — Occupancy, Screening and Guest Limits
content:
Every Apartment Home Lease is written on one of six floor plans, and the floor plan fixes who may live in the apartment home, who may sign for it and what a screening result must show. The figures below apply to the floor plan named on the lease or on the application.

## Schedule

| Floor plan | Bedrooms | Maximum occupants (adults and minors) | Maximum adult applicants | Minimum leaseholder age (full years) | Minimum income multiple of monthly rent | Credit score for approval without conditions | Lowest credit score for approval with conditions | Consecutive guest nights allowed |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Studio Residence | 0 (studio) | 2 | 2 | 18 | 2.75 | 650 | 575 | 14 |
| One-Bedroom Residence | 1 | 3 | 3 | 18 | 2.75 | 650 | 575 | 14 |
| One-Bedroom Den Residence | 1 | 3 | 3 | 18 | 3.00 | 650 | 575 | 14 |
| Two-Bedroom Residence | 2 | 5 | 4 | 18 | 3.00 | 650 | 575 | 14 |
| Three-Bedroom Residence | 3 | 7 | 5 | 18 | 3.00 | 650 | 600 | 14 |
| Penthouse Residence | 3 | 7 | 5 | 18 | 3.25 | 700 | 640 | 14 |

## Meaning of each column

- **Bedrooms** — the number of bedrooms in the floor plan; a studio counts as 0.
- **Maximum occupants** — the most persons, adults and minors together, who may occupy the floor plan.
- **Maximum adult applicants** — the most adult applicants who may sign the lease for the floor plan.
- **Minimum leaseholder age** — the age in full years every leaseholder must have reached on the application date.
- **Minimum income multiple** — the combined gross monthly income of all adult applicants, expressed as a multiple of the monthly rent, that the floor plan requires.
- **Credit score for approval without conditions** — the lowest screening credit score that yields an approval with no conditions.
- **Lowest credit score for approval with conditions** — the lowest screening credit score that yields an approval with conditions; below it the application is denied.
- **Consecutive guest nights allowed** — the consecutive nights a guest may stay before the guest is treated as an unauthorized occupant.

## Reading the schedule

**Which floor plans share the same household limits?** The One-Bedroom Residence and the One-Bedroom Den Residence both admit 3 occupants and 3 adult applicants; the Three-Bedroom Residence and the Penthouse Residence both admit 7 occupants and 5 adult applicants.

**Where do the screening scores differ?** Five floor plans approve without conditions from a score of 650; the Penthouse Residence requires 700. The lowest score for a conditional approval is 575 on the Studio, One-Bedroom, One-Bedroom Den and Two-Bedroom Residences, 600 on the Three-Bedroom Residence and 640 on the Penthouse Residence.

**Hypothetical illustration.** On a quoted monthly rent of $2,000.00, the income multiple of 3.00 on the Two-Bedroom Residence corresponds to combined gross monthly income of $6,000.00; the multiple of 2.75 on the Studio Residence would correspond to $5,500.00. The rent figure is an example input, not a quoted rent.
